appearanceHint: Theme matches the sidebar control and applies across the whole app. Language is saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.
languageHint: Menus, buttons and messages switch language. Questions and course content stay as written.
languageSavedBody: The app now uses your chosen language.
companyTestsDesc: Practise each company’s real test pattern: timed sections, cut-offs and marking, at three levels.
noCompanyTestsDesc: Company test patterns are being prepared. Browse company pages or take an AI mock test meanwhile.
noTestsMatchDesc: Try another company name, or clear the search.
unverifiedHint: Based on commonly reported public information
ctLoadFailed: Couldn’t load this test. Refresh to try again.
ctOpenRunFailedRefresh: Couldn’t open that run. Refresh to try again.
ctStartFailed: Couldn’t start the test. Please try again.
ctStartFailedConnection: Couldn’t start the test. Check your connection and try again.
ctNotAvailableDesc: It may have been removed. Pick a company to see its practice tests.
ctPractiseDesc: Each section runs on its own timer and closes when time is up, like the real test. Your score per section is compared with the cut-off.
ctUnverifiedNote: This pattern is based on commonly reported public information and hasn’t been checked against the company’s current test yet.
ctNegativeMarking: Wrong answers lose {mark} of a mark; blank answers lose nothing.
ctNoNegative: No negative marking: answer every question.
ctCantGoBack: You can’t go back to a section once you submit it.
ctLevelIncomplete: This level is still being completed, so some sections may be shorter than the real test.
ctAutoSubmitFailed: Time is up but your answers didn’t reach us. Try again.
ctSubmitFailed: Couldn’t submit this section. Try again.
ctVersionIncomplete: This version is still being completed, so it may be shorter than the real test.
submitSectionBody: You’ve answered {n} of {m}. You can’t come back to this section after submitting.
ctPassedAll: You cleared the overall and every section cut-off in this run.
ctCompareSections: Compare each section with its cut-off below, then review the questions.
negativeApplied: Negative marking applied: −{mark} per wrong objective answer.
scorePerSectionCaption: Score per section compared with the cut-off
spLoadFailed: We could not load your study plan
spSetupDesc: Tell us your goal and how much time you have. We build each week from your own test results and adjust it as you go.
spUpdated: Plan updated from your latest results
spEnded: Your plan has ended. Well done — set a new goal to keep going.
nothingTodayDesc: Take a break, or get ahead with tomorrow’s items below.
weakAreasEmpty: Take a test or a practice set and your weak areas show up here.
spWhatsappConsent: WhatsApp (only if you agreed to WhatsApp messages in your notification settings)
spTimesIn: Times are in {tz}. You can unsubscribe from any reminder e-mail.
psNotAvailable: This practice set is not available
psScore: You got {score} of {total} answered questions right. Your plan uses this to pick next week’s topics.
simDesc: Practise a real interview round with an AI interviewer, then get scored feedback, model answers and what to study next.
simOffDesc: Your platform admin has paused mock interviews. Check back later, or practise with interview prep questions.
simSetUpDesc: {q} questions, about {min} minutes. {left} of {max} left today.
voiceModeHint: The interviewer reads questions aloud and your browser turns your speech into text. If your browser can’t, you can still type.
recordSessionHint: (optional) — so you can watch yourself back. Kept for {days} days, then deleted. You can delete it any time.
beforeMicOrCamera: Before we use your microphone or camera
micNoticeBrowser: Your browser asks for microphone access. Speech is turned into text in your browser; we keep the text of your answers, not the audio.
micNoticeServer: Your browser asks for microphone access. Speech is turned into text in your browser, or by our speech-to-text provider if your browser can’t; we keep the text of your answers, not the audio.
recordingNotice: If you start a recording, it is stored privately on our servers for {days} days, visible only to you, then deleted automatically.
aiScoredNotice: Your answers are scored by an AI model. Don’t share personal details you wouldn’t say in an interview.
simDailyUsed: You’ve used today’s mock interviews. Come back tomorrow.
reportsPrivate: Reports are private to you unless you share a link.
noInterviewsYetDesc: Set up your first round above — you’ll see your scores and feedback here.
simEnterRole: Enter the role you are preparing for.
simAcceptNotice: Please read and accept the microphone notice first.
simStartFailed: The interview could not start. Try again.
simDeleteConfirm: Delete this interview, its report and any recording? This cannot be undone.
roundHint:hr: Motivation, teamwork, conflict, ownership. Answer with STAR.
roundHint:technical: Core CS and role topics: explain, compare, trade-offs.
roundHint:coding: Talk through an approach, write code in the editor, run it.
roundHint:system_design: Requirements, high-level design, data, scale, trade-offs.
recordingSaveFailed: The recording could not be saved.
recordingUnsupported: Recording is not supported in this browser.
recordingAudioOnly: Recording audio only (video needs large uploads, which are off on this site).
recordingBlocked: Camera or microphone access was blocked. The interview continues without a recording.
simSessionLoadFailed: This interview could not be loaded.
typeOrSayFirst: Type or say your answer first.
answerNotSent: Your answer was not sent. Try again.
endNowConfirm: End the interview now? Your report will cover the questions you answered.
shareCreatedBody: Copied to your clipboard. Anyone with the link can see the report (not your answers).
sharingOffBody: The old link no longer works.
deleteRecordingConfirm: Delete the recording now? This cannot be undone.
linkCopiedBody: Share it with a mentor or friend.
recordingOptional: Recording is optional. Start it when you’re ready — it stops when the interview ends.
voicePlaceholder: Press “Answer by voice” and speak, or type here.
typePlaceholder: Type your answer as you would say it.
voiceUnavailable: Voice input isn’t available in this browser — type your answer instead (Chrome and Edge support it).
recordingKeptUntil: Your recording is kept until {date}, then deleted automatically.
noReportDesc: It ended before any answer was scored. Start a new one when you’re ready.
copilotModelSet: Set in the platform AI settings. If it is busy, the copilot switches to a backup model.
copilotModelUnset: No model is set in the platform AI settings, so the copilot uses the first available backup model.
copilotEmptyTitle: What can I help you set up?
copilotEmptyDesc: Ask about your tests, candidates and events, or have me draft a change. I always show you a preview first — nothing is saved or sent until you confirm it.
copilotStarter1: Create a backend engineer test from this job description
copilotStarter2: Set up a campus drive next month: a test, a hackathon and invites
copilotStarter3: Who should we shortlist for the Backend Engineer job?
copilotStarter4: Every Monday at 9:00, email me new applicants
copilotPlaceholder: Ask the copilot… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
copilotDisclaimer: The copilot can make mistakes. Check previews before you confirm.
mmDesc: Picked from your focus areas, target company, language and time zone.
mmEmpty: No mentor matches yet. Practise a bit more or browse all mentors.
